zh.title: 瑞士國際航空擬於2027年底前退役全數A220-100客機
zh.summary: 瑞士國際航空宣布計劃在2027年底前退役旗下剩餘的空中巴士A220-100窄體客機，全面過渡至由A220-300組成的機隊。該航司過去共引進9架A220-100，目前已有5架退役，僅剩4架仍在營運。此舉亦受普惠發動機供應與維修資源調配影響。
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）宣布計劃在2027年底前退役旗下剩餘的空中巴士A220-100窄體客機機隊，結束約十年的營運，並將業務全面過渡至全A220-300機隊。在該航司最初取得的9架A220-100之中，目前已有5架退出服務，僅剩4架機體仍維持運作，預計將於2027年底前全部退役。
瑞士國際航空於2016年7月成為A220-100（當時稱為龐巴迪CSeries CS100）的全球首發客戶。該機型的引進代表了當時航司機隊更新戰略的重要一步，用以取代逐漸老化的Avro RJ100區域客機，該型機採用全新設計並由雙具普惠PW1500G齒輪傳動渦輪風扇發動機驅動。
在機隊組成方面，瑞士國際航空共引進了9架較小的A220-100以及21架較大的A220-300客機。在瑞士國際航空的客艙配置下，A220-300可容納約145名乘客，而較小的A220-100則僅有125個座位。在面對營運成本上升與運力限制的環境下，A220-300提供的額外座位展現出更強的商業效益。
此外，淘汰A220-100機隊的決定亦與普惠發動機的供應與維修瓶頸有關。面對維修延誤與零組件短缺導致的運營挑戰，瑞士國際航空選擇將有限的發動機、零組件與MRO維修資源優先集中於運量較大的A220-300機隊，最終決定全數退役A220-100機型。

en.title: SWISS to Retire Remaining Airbus A220-100 Fleet by End of 2027
en.summary: SWISS has announced plans to retire its remaining Airbus A220-100 fleet by the end of 2027 as the airline transitions to an all-A220-300 narrowbody operation. Having served as the global launch customer for the aircraft type in July 2016, SWISS originally acquired nine A220-100s. Five of these airframes have already been removed from service, leaving four active aircraft. The decision is driven by fleet simplification goals, higher seat capacity on the A220-300 variant, and ongoing Pratt & Whitney engine availability and maintenance challenges.
body: Swiss national flag carrier SWISS has announced official plans to withdraw its remaining Airbus A220-100 narrowbody airliner fleet from commercial service by the end of 2027 after a decade of operations. The carrier is transitioning its narrowbody fleet to an all-A220-300 operation. Out of the original nine A220-100 aircraft acquired by SWISS, the airline has already removed five airframes from active service, leaving four operational units set for retirement.

SWISS originally became the global launch customer for the Airbus A220-100 in July 2016, when the aircraft platform was known as the Bombardier CSeries CS100. The arrival of the clean-sheet airliner represented a major milestone in the carrier's fleet renewal strategy, replacing its aging fleet of Avro RJ100 regional jets. The aircraft were equipped with advanced aerodynamics and powered by a pair of Pratt & Whitney PW1500G geared turbofan engines.

Throughout its operational history, SWISS acquired a total of nine smaller A220-100s alongside a larger fleet of 21 A220-300 aircraft. In the SWISS cabin configuration, the larger A220-300 accommodates around 145 passengers, whereas the smaller A220-100 provides only 125 seats. Amid industry-wide pressures from rising operating costs and capacity constraints, the additional passenger seats offered by the -300 variant present a stronger commercial proposition while maintaining overall fleet efficiency.

The decision to retire the A220-100 fleet also comes as SWISS manages the ongoing impact of Pratt & Whitney engine availability issues affecting geared turbofan platforms. Maintenance delays, spare-part shortages, and extended engine shop visits created persistent operational challenges. SWISS initially prioritized engine availability for its larger A220-300s by sacrificing smaller -100s, later concluding that its limited spare engines, components, and MRO resources are best focused on the larger variant.

zh.title: 東航 A320 B-8228 抵達桃園機場 觀測
zh.summary: 公開 ADS‑B 資料顯示，中國東方航空一架註冊 B-8228 的空中巴士 A320 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日 11:32 UTC 確認抵達桃園機場（TPE），觀測系統記錄兩筆有效軌跡，並依據機場地理圍欄與地面高度判定抵達。
body: 本站監測系統於 2026-08-08T10:29:18Z 首次捕捉到呼號 CES5002、註冊號 B-8228 的空中巴士 A320 進入桃園機場 RCTP 空域。
經過兩筆有效觀測後，系統於 2026-08-08T11:32:18Z 判定該航空器已確認抵達，判定依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且氣壓高度為地面。
航空器 ICAO 十六進制代碼為 780740，機型代碼 A320，顯示名稱為 Airbus A320，營運者 ICAO 代碼 CES，名稱為 China Eastern Airlines。
觀測記錄顯示該航班呼號為 CES5002，屬於中國東方航空運營，屬於公開 ADS‑B 觀測資料，主要來源為 Airplanes.live，第二來源為 ADSB.lol。
統計說明指出系統觀測歷史累積中尚無可比較的長期統計，因此此次抵達屬於本站記錄中的少見組合。

en.title: China Eastern Airbus A320 B-8228 arrives at Taiwan Taoyuan Airport per ADS‑B observation
en.summary: Public ADS‑B data shows a China Eastern Airlines Airbus A320 registered B-8228, operating under callsign CES5002, was confirmed to have arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on 8 August 2026 at 11:32 UTC. The monitoring system recorded two valid tracks and confirmed the arrival based on the aircraft being inside the airport geofence with a ground barometric altitude. No long‑term statistical comparison is available in the observation history.
body: The monitoring system first detected the aircraft with ICAO hex 780740, registration B-8228, and callsign CES5002 entering the Taoyuan RCTP airspace at 2026-08-08T10:29:18Z.

After two valid observations, the system confirmed arrival at 2026-08-08T11:32:18Z, using the criteria that the aircraft was within the airport geofence and its barometric altitude indicated ground level.
The aircraft type is an Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), operated by China Eastern Airlines (ICAO operator code CES).
The observation originates from public ADS‑B sources, primarily Airplanes.live with a secondary feed from ADSB.lol, and the cross‑check status is confirmed by primary source only.
The statistical note states that the observation history has no comparable long‑term statistics, making this arrival a rare combination in the site’s records.

body: 根據觀測資料，此次航班的事件 ID 為 fw-d1cfe5f2127d531f。

航空器的 ICAO hex 為 a65092，註冊號為 N506DN，呼號為 DAL69。
營運者 ICAO 為 DAL，營運者名稱為 Delta Air Lines，機型為 A359（Airbus A350-900）。
